title: Canva for patient information
why: Patients remember a clear leaflet far better than a rushed explanation. Good visuals improve understanding and adherence.
what_is_different: Health materials must be accurate, plain-language (around reading age 11–12), culturally appropriate, translatable, and reviewed before use. Pictograms and large fonts matter more than decoration.

extra_modules.title: Plain-language health writing
extra_modules.outcome: You can: write instructions patients understand
extra_modules.practice: Rewrite a medication instruction in plain language

extra_modules.title: Multilingual versions
extra_modules.outcome: You can: produce leaflets in local languages
extra_modules.practice: Produce a leaflet in two languages

starter_project: Create a one-page leaflet for a common condition or medicine with pictograms, a plain-language version reviewed by a colleague, and a translated version reviewed by a native speaker.
pitfalls: No date or source for clinical information

expert_validation.note: AI-drafted outline; to be validated by a practitioner and an educator in this field.
